title: Qualcomm wins import ban against several Apple iPhones in China
text: Qualcomm wins import ban against several Apple iPhones in China Monday, 10 December 2018 ( 1 hour ago ) Qualcomm Inc on Monday said it had won a preliminary order from a Chinese court banning the importation and sale of several Apple Inc iPhone models in China that the court found violated two of Qualcomm patents. ▶ Apple Hopes HomePod Will Be A Success In China 00:32 The Apple HomePod will launch in China in early 2019, according to Digital Trends. The HomePod will support both Mandarin and Cantonese dialects of the Chinese language. The HomePod will be available in white or deep gray for approximately $407.
